Name: Increase prices of new 1.6 crops
Author: Roseloves109
Description:
I really don't like the new crops added in new update. They are hard to get and they not good making makers. I changed the prices of the new crops. I increase the prices to make them worth it lol. 

Carrot is now 60g (In game Price is 35g)
Summer Squash is now 80g (In game Price is 45g)
Broccoli is now 100g (In game Price is 70g)
Powermolen is now 150g (In game Price is 60g)

[b]Please dont forget to endorse the my mod please, so that way more people can see it. It helps inspires me to make mods/unofficial updates. ;)[/b]
